claim.statement: The publisher's README at tag 1.16.0 describes --llm-approve as using an LLM-based security analyzer to decide action approval.

source.title: OpenHands CLI README at tag 1.16.0
source.locator: Features — Confirmation Modes — LLM-based security analyzer

limitations: This is a version-pinned publisher description, not an independent assessment of the analyzer.
The selected source does not establish the analyzer model, prompt, thresholds, failure behavior or coverage for every action type.
unknowns: The analyzer's false-positive and false-negative rates are unknown.
The exact model and data sent for approval analysis in a particular session are unknown.

relationships.note: The apparent conflict is resolved because LLM-based approval and always-ask are mutually exclusive confirmation configurations.
